name: pyramid-task
description: Build, expand with approval, execute, audit, repair, close, archive, restore, and visualize evidence-backed task pyramids.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed planning for agents and humans.
interface.longDescription: Turn an intent into a validated pathfinder graph, recursively expand broad work with explicit user approval, execute agent task packets, enforce audit gates, manage the full lifecycle, and explore an interactive human-readable task map.
defaultPrompt: Turn this feature into an evidence-backed task pyramid.
Show what is ready, active, blocked, and unaudited.
Propose and preview a safe expansion for this broad task.
